stem:
Simran tests one food: iodine goes blue-black and the paper shows an oily patch.

What should she conclude?

options.text: One food item can contain only one nutrient.
One food item can contain more than one nutrient.
The two tests cancel, so the food has no nutrient.
Only the blue-black colour counts; the oily patch does not.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue-black iodine and an oily patch show two nutrients in one food.
